_comment: Per-contract wasm size budgets in bytes. Update via scripts/update-wasm-budgets.sh after intentional size changes.
_update_process: To update budgets: 1) Run 'cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release' for each contract, 2) Record new sizes, 3) Run 'scripts/update-wasm-budgets.sh' or manually update this file, 4) Commit the change for review.

bounty_escrow.description: Bounty escrow contract. Budget raised from 319488 → 352256 (+32768 B) in issue #1882 to accommodate the analytics/monitoring surface: get_escrow_count, query_escrows_by_status, query_escrows_by_depositor, get_escrow_ids_by_status, updated query_escrows_by_amount, updated query_escrows_by_deadline (now return Vec<EscrowWithId>) and their paginate_escrows_with_id helper.
